## Risks this register does not address

- It runs against a PGlite rebuild, not the live database. A policy
  dropped by hand in the Supabase dashboard would not be caught here.
- `auth.uid()` is a stub reading a GUC. A policy depending on any other
  JWT claim is not exercised.
- Application-layer authorization is covered by `rls.mjs` and
  `behaviour.mjs`, not by this file.
